# Parent Gadget Checker

Takes up to 5 claims about a gadget — specs, output numbers, battery, compatibility — and verifies each against the manufacturer's page and spec sheet only. You get a verdict per claim (Confirmed, Corrected, or Unverifiable), a Safe-to-say list, a Do-not-say list, and parent-fit notes on weight, size, and one-hand use.
